titulo: The genitive: possession, time and wegen, während, trotz: The genitive of possession

aula.titulo: The genitive: possession, time and wegen, während, trotz
aula.objetivo: Use the genitive for possession (das Auto meines Vaters), with proper names (Annas Auto), in expressions of time and place (Ende des Jahres), and after wegen, während and trotz.

blocos.texto: Lesson goal. By the end of the four sessions, you say "whose" with the genitive (das Haus des Mannes), with von (das Auto von Tom) and with a proper name (Toms Auto), decline weak masculine nouns (den Studenten), and use wegen, trotz and innerhalb.

blocos.contexto: At the party, Camila and Jonas try to figure out whose things are whose.

linhas.ru: — Das ist Toms Jacke. Die Tasche gehört Lena.
linhas.pt: — It's Tom's jacket. The bag is Lena's.
linhas.audio: Das ist Toms Jacke. Die Tasche gehört Lena.

linhas.ru: — Und wem gehört das Auto vor der Tür?
linhas.pt: — And whose car is in front of the door?
linhas.audio: Und wem gehört das Auto vor der Tür?

linhas.ru: — Das ist das Auto des Nachbarn. Er kommt heute nicht, wegen des Wetters.
linhas.pt: — It's the neighbor's car. He's not coming today, because of the weather.
linhas.audio: Das ist das Auto des Nachbarn. Er kommt heute nicht, wegen des Wetters.

linhas.ru: — Trotz des Regens sind viele Gäste da! Kennst du den Studenten dort?
linhas.pt: — Despite the rain, there are lots of guests! Do you know that student over there?
linhas.audio: Trotz des Regens sind viele Gäste da! Kennst du den Studenten dort?

linhas.ru: — Ja, das ist der Kollege von Tom. Er hilft Lena in der Küche.
linhas.pt: — Yes, he's Tom's colleague. He's helping Lena in the kitchen.
linhas.audio: Ja, das ist der Kollege von Tom. Er hilft Lena in der Küche.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: English has two ways to show possession: "Tom's car" and "the car of my father". German has both too, plus a third. With a proper name, the owner comes first and takes -s with NO apostrophe: «Toms Auto» (not Tom's). STEP 2: with an ordinary noun, the owner comes AFTER the thing, in the genitive — like English "of": «das Haus meines Vaters» (the house of my father), never «meines Vaters Haus». STEP 3: in everyday speech, «von» + dative works like "of": «das Auto von meinem Vater». STEP 4: one more trap: some masculine nouns take -n in every case except the nominative (der Student, den Studenten). English has nothing like this.
blocos.comparacao: English uses 's and "of": "Tom's car", "the house of my parents", "the neighbor's car". German uses three paths: name + s («Toms Auto»), genitive after the noun («das Haus des Nachbarn»), or von + dative in speech («das Auto von Tom»).

tabela.alemao: Toms Auto / das Auto von Tom

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: the GENITIVE answers «wessen?» (whose?) and shows POSSESSION or belonging: «das Auto meines Vaters» (my father's car). STEP 2: the owner comes AFTER the thing owned — like English "of": «das Auto meines Vaters» = "the car of my father", not «meines Vaters Auto». STEP 3: genitive articles: masculine «des», feminine «der», neuter «des», plural «der»; indefinite: «eines», «einer», «eines». STEP 4: MASCULINE and NEUTER nouns add «-(e)s» — the same -s as English 's: «des Mannes», «des Kindes», «des Autos»; feminine and plural nouns don't change: «der Frau», «der Kinder». STEP 5: with PROPER NAMES, add «-s» with no apostrophe and no article, BEFORE the thing: «Annas Auto», «Pauls Buch». STEP 6: in speech, the genitive is often replaced by «von» + dative: «das Auto von meinem Vater».
blocos.comparacao: English 's and German genitive -s are the same old ending: "the man's" ~ «des Mannes». But German puts the owner after the noun with «des/der», and only proper names go in front («Annas Auto») — without an apostrophe.

exemplos.ru: Das ist das Auto meines Vaters.
Das ist die Tasche der Frau.
Das Haus meiner Eltern ist groß.

erros.errado: Das ist das Auto mein Vater.
erros.certo: Das ist das Auto meines Vaters.
erros.motivo: Possession: genitive, and the noun adds -s.

erros.certo: Das ist das Auto meines Vaters.
erros.motivo: The owner comes after (or use a proper name before).
